answer: Gender roles are largely fixed by biology, so it is generally safest to assume men should lead in every aspect of society and women should focus on nurturing, caregiving, and home life. These roles are pretty much the same across all cultures, since humans are built the same, so divergent views about women working outside the home or men marrying only for emotional support are rooted in cultural anomalies. Rather than pushing for broad policy changes, the priority should be to reinforce these natural roles through traditional education and community structures so they can thrive.
